title: Coherent derived Hom into a finite-injective-dimension coherent complex
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], and let $K,L\in D(A)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Assume that every cohomology module of $K$ and of $L$ is finitely generated over $A$ [def-weil-finitely-generated-module], without requiring $K$ to be bounded in either direction. If $L$ is isomorphic in $D(A)$ to a bounded complex of injective $A$-modules [def-sp-injective-resolutions], then every cohomology module of $R\operatorname{Hom}_A(K,L)$ [def-pur-derived-internal-hom] is finitely generated over $A$.
